description:
optional, enumerated string filter
The credit note type. Possible values are : adjustment, refundable.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → type[is_not] = "adjustment"

is.description: \* \`adjustment\` - Adjustment Credit Note \* \`refundable\` - Refundable Credit Note \* \`store\` - Store Credit Note

is_not.description: \* \`adjustment\` - Adjustment Credit Note \* \`refundable\` - Refundable Credit Note \* \`store\` - Store Credit Note
